categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in the development, sales, and service of commercial middleware software. It serves key national economic sectors including government, military, finance, energy, and transportation by providing middleware software sales, customized development, and maintenance services. The product portfolio includes foundational middleware such as application servers, message middleware, workflow middleware, enterprise service buses, and broad middleware products like IoT platforms, PaaS platforms, big data governance, and AI model management platforms.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages over 20 years of R&D experience in middleware technologies, holding core proprietary technologies and intellectual property. Key technologies include high-performance application servers, communication and application collaboration, agile business process platforms, lightweight secure PaaS platforms, complex IoT platforms, application security, cloud-native integrated service management, and real-time stream processing. The company follows CMMI DEV Level 5 quality standards and integrates cloud-native, microservices, containerization, and AI technologies in product development.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company serves primarily government agencies, military units, financial institutions, energy companies, and transportation sectors. It also extends services to education, healthcare, manufacturing, and insurance industries. Its middleware products support digital transformation and IT infrastructure modernization in these key sectors, with a focus on domestic market penetration and replacing foreign middleware products.
categories.geographic_coverage: Operations and sales are concentrated within China, with no significant overseas business reported. The company is headquartered in Jinan, Shandong Province, and serves customers across multiple provinces including Shandong, Sichuan, Jiangxi, and Heilongjiang.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream segment of the software supply chain as a developer and provider of middleware software products and related services. It is upstream in the sense of providing foundational software that supports application development and IT infrastructure for end users in various industries.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategically, the company focuses on advancing cloud-native middleware solutions, integrating AI capabilities, and expanding digital and intelligent platform offerings. It emphasizes innovation in real-time data processing, IoT, security, and PaaS platforms. The company plans to deepen industry-specific solutions, enhance market penetration, and strengthen its R&D team and ecosystem partnerships to maintain technological leadership and support national digital infrastructure goals.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through direct sales of proprietary middleware software products, customized middleware development services, and middleware operation and maintenance services. The company also benefits from government subsidies and tax incentives related to software development and innovation.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes with international middleware giants like IBM and Oracle, as well as domestic competitors such as Dongfang Tong and Baoland. It positions itself as a leading domestic middleware provider with strong R&D capabilities and a growing market share in the Chinese middleware industry, particularly in the context of national digital security and software localization policies.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 194.25 million, a 7.96% increase year-over-year, with net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 38.72 million, reflecting a decline due to increased R&D and sales expenses. Total assets nearly doubled to RMB 860 million, and net assets attributable to shareholders more than doubled to RMB 811 million, driven by a successful IPO raising significant capital. R&D investment accounted for 29.04% of revenue, highlighting a strong growth and innovation focus.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its comprehensive, high-performance, secure, and scalable middleware product suite with full proprietary intellectual property rights, enabling it to break foreign technology monopolies. It offers integrated cloud-native and AI-enabled middleware solutions tailored to critical national sectors, supporting digital transformation and secure IT infrastructure. Its products are certified to international standards and adapted for domestic hardware and software environments, providing reliable alternatives to foreign middleware products.
